text:
The 71 core funds with a flow took in a net $5.43B over their latest reported period, Sep 17–18 to Sep 24–25. IUSB accounts for $4.34B of that after its share count rose 10% in the week; the other 70 funds netted +$1.09B. The largest inflows went to HYG (+$893M), SGOV (+$840M) and MUB (+$616M), and the largest outflows came from MBB (−$1.44B), EMB (−$662M) and USHY (−$534M).

Looking through to holdings, agency MBS demand was −$430M, because MBB's redemption outweighed the MBS share of IUSB's and AGG's inflows. These are week-long catch-up totals from the pipeline's first two usable observations, and they don't yet include Vanguard's 16 funds, BND among them.
